title: Correct Z1 Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z1 must be correctly expressed as (1 + exp(-beta epsilon) + exp(-2 beta epsilon))^2.

title: Correct Z2 Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z2 must be correctly derived as Z1/2.

title: Correct Z3 Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z3 must be correctly expressed as (1 + exp(-beta epsilon) + exp(-2 beta epsilon)) * exp(-beta epsilon).

title: Correct Z4 Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z4 must be correctly expressed as (1 + exp(-beta epsilon) + exp(-2 beta epsilon)) * (1 + exp(-2 beta epsilon)).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the exponential terms of the partition functions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that no factors are omitted in the expressions for the partition functions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Check that all terms are dimensionally consistent, particularly in the context of beta.
